verses.original: Καὶ ἔδειξέν μοι ποταμὸν ὕδατος ζωῆς λαμπρὸν ὡς κρύσταλλον ἐκπορευόμενον ἐκ τοῦ θρόνου τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ τοῦ Ἀρνίου
verses.transliteration: Kai edeixen moi potamon hydatos zōēs lampron hōs krystallon ekporeuomenon ek tou thronou tou Theou kai tou Arniou
verses.literal: Then the angel showed me a river of the water of life as clear as crystal flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb
verses.literalPt: E MOSTROU-ME o rio puro da água da vida, claro como cristal, que procedia do trono de Deus e do Cordeiro.

verses.original: ἐν μέσῳ τῆς πλατείας αὐτῆς καὶ τοῦ ποταμοῦ ἐντεῦθεν καὶ ἐκεῖθεν ξύλον ζωῆς ποιοῦν καρποὺς δώδεκα κατὰ μῆνα ἕκαστον ἀποδιδοῦν τὸν καρπὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ φύλλα τοῦ ξύλου εἰς θεραπείαν τῶν ἐθνῶν
verses.transliteration: en mesō tēs plateias autēs kai tou potamou enteuthen kai ekeithen xylon zōēs poioun karpous dōdeka kata mēna hekaston apodidoun ton karpon autou kai ta phylla tou xylou eis therapeian tōn ethnōn
verses.literal: down the middle of the main street of the city On either side . . . . . . of the river stood a tree of life bearing twelve kinds of fruit and yielding a fresh crop for each month And the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations
verses.literalPt: No meio da sua praça, e de um e de outro lado do rio, estava a árvore da vida, que produz doze frutos, dando seu fruto de mês em mês; e as folhas da árvore são para a saúde das nações.

verses.original: Καὶ πᾶν κατάθεμα οὐκ ἔσται ἔτι καὶ ὁ θρόνος τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ τοῦ Ἀρνίου ἐν αὐτῇ ἔσται καὶ οἱ δοῦλοι αὐτοῦ λατρεύσουσιν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Kai pan katathema ouk estai eti kai ho thronos tou Theou kai tou Arniou en autē estai kai hoi douloi autou latreusousin autō
verses.literal: No longer will there be any curse The throne of God and of the Lamb will be within the city and His servants will worship Him
verses.literalPt: E ali nunca mais haverá maldição contra alguém; e nela estará o trono de Deus e do Cordeiro, e os seus servos o servirão.

verses.original: καὶ ὄψονται τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τῶν μετώπων αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: kai opsontai to prosōpon autou kai to onoma autou epi tōn metōpōn autōn
verses.literal: They will see His face and His name will be on their foreheads
verses.literalPt: E verão o seu rosto, e nas suas testas estará o seu nome.

verses.original: καὶ νὺξ οὐκ ἔσται ἔτι καὶ οὐκ ἔχουσιν χρείαν φωτὸς λύχνου καὶ φωτὸς ἡλίου ὅτι Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς φωτίσει ἐπ’ αὐτούς καὶ βασιλεύσουσιν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων
verses.transliteration: kai nyx ouk estai eti kai ouk echousin chreian phōtos lychnou kai phōtos hēliou hoti Kyrios ho Theos phōtisei ep’ autous kai basileusousin eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn
verses.literal: There will be no more night in the city and they will have no need for the light of a lamp or of the sun For the Lord God will shine on them and they will reign forever and ever
verses.literalPt: E ali não haverá mais noite, e não necessitarão de lâmpada nem de luz do sol, porque o Senhor Deus os ilumina; e reinarão para todo o sempre.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπέν μοι Οὗτοι οἱ λόγοι πιστοὶ καὶ ἀληθινοί καὶ ὁ Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς τῶν πνευμάτων τῶν προφητῶν ἀπέστειλεν τὸν ἄγγελον αὐτοῦ δεῖξαι τοῖς δούλοις αὐτοῦ ἃ δεῖ γενέσθαι ἐν τάχει
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen moi Houtoi hoi logoi pistoi kai alēthinoi kai ho Kyrios ho Theos tōn pneumatōn tōn prophētōn apesteilen ton angelon autou deixai tois doulois autou ha dei genesthai en tachei
verses.literal: Then the angel said to me These words are faithful and true The Lord the God of the spirits of the prophets has sent His angel to show His servants what must soon take place
verses.literalPt: E disse-me: Estas palavras são fiéis e verdadeiras; e o Senhor, o Deus dos santos profetas, enviou o seu anjo, para mostrar aos seus servos as coisas que em breve hão de acontecer.

verses.original: Καὶ ἰδοὺ ἔρχομαι ταχύ μακάριος ὁ τηρῶν τοὺς λόγους τῆς προφητείας τοῦ βιβλίου τούτου
verses.transliteration: Kai idou erchomai tachy makarios ho tērōn tous logous tēs prophēteias tou bibliou toutou
verses.literal: Behold I am coming soon Blessed is the one who keeps the words of prophecy in this book
verses.literalPt: Eis que presto venho: Bem-aventurado aquele que guarda as palavras da profecia deste livro.

verses.original: Κἀγὼ Ἰωάννης ὁ ἀκούων καὶ βλέπων ταῦτα καὶ ὅτε ἤκουσα καὶ ἔβλεψα ἔπεσα προσκυνῆσαι ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ποδῶν τοῦ ἀγγέλου τοῦ δεικνύοντός μοι ταῦτα
verses.transliteration: Kagō Iōannēs ho akouōn kai blepōn tauta kai hote ēkousa kai eblepsa epesa proskynēsai emprosthen tōn podōn tou angelou tou deiknyontos moi tauta
verses.literal: And I John am the one who heard and saw these things And when I had heard and seen them I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown me these things
verses.literalPt: E eu, João, sou aquele que vi e ouvi estas coisas. E, havendo-as ouvido e visto, prostrei-me aos pés do anjo que mas mostrava para o adorar.

verses.original: καὶ λέγει μοι Ὅρα μή σύνδουλός σού εἰμι καὶ τῶν ἀδελφῶν σου τῶν προφητῶν καὶ τῶν τηρούντων τοὺς λόγους τοῦ βιβλίου τούτου τῷ Θεῷ προσκύνησον
verses.transliteration: kai legei moi Hora mē syndoulos sou eimi kai tōn adelphōn sou tōn prophētōn kai tōn tērountōn tous logous tou bibliou toutou tō Theō proskynēson
verses.literal: But he said to me Do not do that . . . I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers the prophets and with those who keep the words of this book Worship God
verses.literalPt: E disse-me: Olha, não faças tal; porque eu sou conservo teu e de teus irmãos, os profetas, e dos que guardam as palavras deste livro. Adora a Deus.

verses.original: Καὶ λέγει μοι Μὴ σφραγίσῃς τοὺς λόγους τῆς προφητείας τοῦ βιβλίου τούτου ὁ καιρὸς γὰρ ἐγγύς ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: Kai legei moi Mē sphragisēs tous logous tēs prophēteias tou bibliou toutou ho kairos gar engys estin
verses.literal: Then he told me Do not seal up the words of prophecy in this book because the time is near
verses.literalPt: E disse-me: Não seles as palavras da profecia deste livro; porque próximo está o tempo.

verses.original: ὁ ἀδικῶν ἀδικησάτω ἔτι καὶ ὁ ῥυπαρὸς ῥυπανθήτω ἔτι καὶ ὁ δίκαιος δικαιοσύνην ποιησάτω ἔτι καὶ ὁ ἅγιος ἁγιασθήτω ἔτι
verses.transliteration: ho adikōn adikēsatō eti kai ho rhyparos rhypanthētō eti kai ho dikaios dikaiosynēn poiēsatō eti kai ho hagios hagiasthētō eti
verses.literal: Let the unrighteous continue to be unrighteous . . . and the vile continue to be vile . . . let the righteous continue to practice . . . righteousness and the holy continue to be holy . . .
verses.literalPt: Quem é injusto, faça injustiça ainda; e quem está sujo, suje-se ainda; e quem é justo, faça justiça ainda; e quem é santo, seja santificado ainda.

verses.original: Ἰδοὺ ἔρχομαι ταχύ καὶ ὁ μισθός μου μετ’ ἐμοῦ ἀποδοῦναι ἑκάστῳ ὡς τὸ ἔργον ἐστὶν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Idou erchomai tachy kai ho misthos mou met’ emou apodounai hekastō hōs to ergon estin autou
verses.literal: Behold I am coming soon and My reward is with Me to give to each one according to . . . what he has done
verses.literalPt: E, eis que cedo venho, e o meu galardão está comigo, para dar a cada um segundo a sua obra.

verses.original: ἐγὼ τὸ Ἄλφα καὶ τὸ Ὦ ὁ πρῶτος καὶ ὁ ἔσχατος ἡ ἀρχὴ καὶ τὸ τέλος
verses.transliteration: egō to Alpha kai to Ō ho prōtos kai ho eschatos hē archē kai to telos
verses.literal: I am the Alpha and the Omega the First and the Last the Beginning and the End
verses.literalPt: Eu sou o Alfa e o Ômega, o princípio e o fim, o primeiro e o derradeiro.

verses.original: Μακάριοι οἱ πλύνοντες τὰς στολὰς αὐτῶν ἵνα ἔσται ἡ ἐξουσία αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὸ ξύλον τῆς ζωῆς καὶ τοῖς πυλῶσιν εἰσέλθωσιν εἰς τὴν πόλιν
verses.transliteration: Makarioi hoi plynontes tas stolas autōn hina estai hē exousia autōn epi to xylon tēs zōēs kai tois pylōsin eiselthōsin eis tēn polin
verses.literal: Blessed are those who wash their robes so that they may have the right to the tree of life and may enter . . . the city by its gates
verses.literalPt: Bem-aventurados aqueles que guardam os seus mandamentos, para que tenham direito à árvore da vida, e possam entrar na cidade pelas portas.

verses.original: ἔξω οἱ κύνες καὶ οἱ φάρμακοι καὶ οἱ πόρνοι καὶ οἱ φονεῖς καὶ οἱ εἰδωλολάτραι καὶ πᾶς φιλῶν καὶ ποιῶν ψεῦδος
verses.transliteration: exō hoi kynes kai hoi pharmakoi kai hoi pornoi kai hoi phoneis kai hoi eidōlolatrai kai pas philōn kai poiōn pseudos
verses.literal: But outside are the dogs the sorcerers the sexually immoral the murderers the idolaters and everyone who loves and practices falsehood
verses.literalPt: Ficarão de fora os cães e os feiticeiros, e os que se prostituem, e os homicidas, e os idólatras, e qualquer que ama e comete a mentira.

verses.original: Ἐγὼ Ἰησοῦς ἔπεμψα τὸν ἄγγελόν μου μαρτυρῆσαι ὑμῖν ταῦτα ἐπὶ ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ῥίζα καὶ τὸ γένος Δαυίδ ὁ ἀστὴρ ὁ λαμπρός ὁ πρωϊνός
verses.transliteration: Egō Iēsous epempsa ton angelon mou martyrēsai hymin tauta epi tais ekklēsiais egō eimi hē rhiza kai to genos Dauid ho astēr ho lampros ho prōinos
verses.literal: I Jesus have sent My angel to give you this testimony . . . . . . for the churches I am the Root and the Offspring of David the bright Morning Star
verses.literalPt: Eu, Jesus, enviei o meu anjo, para vos testificar estas coisas nas igrejas. Eu sou a raiz e a geração de Davi, a resplandecente estrela da manhã.

verses.original: Καὶ τὸ Πνεῦμα καὶ ἡ νύμφη λέγουσιν Ἔρχου καὶ ὁ ἀκούων εἰπάτω Ἔρχου καὶ ὁ διψῶν ἐρχέσθω ὁ θέλων λαβέτω ὕδωρ ζωῆς δωρεάν
verses.transliteration: Kai to Pneuma kai hē nymphē legousin Erchou kai ho akouōn eipatō Erchou kai ho dipsōn erchesthō ho thelōn labetō hydōr zōēs dōrean
verses.literal: The Spirit and the bride say Come Let the one who hears say Come And let the one who is thirsty come and the one who desires the water of life drink freely
verses.literalPt: E o Espírito e a esposa dizem: Vem. E quem ouve, diga: Vem. E quem tem sede, venha; e quem quiser, tome de graça da água da vida.

verses.original: Μαρτυρῶ ἐγὼ παντὶ τῷ ἀκούοντι τοὺς λόγους τῆς προφητείας τοῦ βιβλίου τούτου ἐάν τις ἐπιθῇ ἐπ’ αὐτά ἐπιθήσει ὁ Θεὸς ἐπ’ αὐτὸν τὰς πληγὰς τὰς γεγραμμένας ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τούτῳ
verses.transliteration: Martyrō egō panti tō akouonti tous logous tēs prophēteias tou bibliou toutou ean tis epithē ep’ auta epithēsei ho Theos ep’ auton tas plēgas tas gegrammenas en tō bibliō toutō
verses.literal: I testify to everyone who hears the words of prophecy in this book If anyone adds to them God will add to him the plagues described in this book
verses.literalPt: Porque eu testifico a todo aquele que ouvir as palavras da profecia deste livro que, se alguém lhes acrescentar alguma coisa, Deus fará vir sobre ele as pragas que estão escritas neste livro;

verses.original: καὶ ἐάν τις ἀφέλῃ ἀπὸ τῶν λόγων τοῦ βιβλίου τῆς προφητείας ταύτης ἀφελεῖ ὁ Θεὸς τὸ μέρος αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ ξύλου τῆς ζωῆς καὶ ἐκ τῆς πόλεως τῆς ἁγίας τῶν γεγραμμένων ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τούτῳ
verses.transliteration: kai ean tis aphelē apo tōn logōn tou bibliou tēs prophēteias tautēs aphelei ho Theos to meros autou apo tou xylou tēs zōēs kai ek tēs poleōs tēs hagias tōn gegrammenōn en tō bibliō toutō
verses.literal: And if anyone takes away from the words of this book of prophecy God will take away his share in the tree of life and the holy city which are described in this book
verses.literalPt: E, se alguém tirar quaisquer palavras do livro desta profecia, Deus tirará a sua parte do livro da vida, e da cidade santa, e das coisas que estão escritas neste livro.

verses.original: Λέγει ὁ μαρτυρῶν ταῦτα Ναί ἔρχομαι ταχύ Ἀμήν ἔρχου Κύριε Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Legei ho martyrōn tauta Nai erchomai tachy Amēn erchou Kyrie Iēsou
verses.literal: He who testifies to these things says Yes I am coming soon Amen Come Lord Jesus
verses.literalPt: Aquele que testifica estas coisas diz: Certamente cedo venho. Amém. Ora vem, Senhor Jesus.

verses.original: Ἡ χάρις τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ μετὰ πάντων ἁγίων Ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: Hē charis tou Kyriou Iēsou meta pantōn hagiōn Amēn
verses.literal: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all the saints Amen
verses.literalPt: A graça de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo seja com todos vós. Amém.
